milestones.title: To Dragonholt
milestones.description: The heroes survive bandits on the road and arrive safely at the village of Dragonholt.

milestones.description: Explore the village, meet key townspeople, and uncover suspicious clues regarding the deceased heir.

milestones.title: The Wilds Beyond

milestones.title: A Barony Reborn
milestones.description: Resolve all remaining personal quests and read the lasting historical epilogue of Terrinoth.
